title: working_tree_clean reds on dirt anywhere in either tree, not only the component's subtree
intention: The build_inspector's working_tree_clean sieve reds on any uncommitted change anywhere in cairn or CairnCommons, not only in the crossing component's own subtree, so no voyage proves while anything rides loose in either tree.
why: Ruling 8w (Akien, verbatim: "yes, rework them that way. and cc++"), layer 3, as narrowed by F11 ("that all sounds good :)") and cleared by 8x ("yes to all."), /home/akien/.cairn/foreground-decisions.md. The one measured orphan (3fef5a02da2d's 413 lab lines in CairnCommons) sat outside every component subtree, so working_tree_clean, which looked only at the crossing component's subtree, passed PROVED twice over it. Dirt anywhere in either tree at a crossing is a voyage leaning on loose work (8t).
traces_to: Law 8 and ruling 8t (a crossing must not lean on another ticket's unproved build: dirt anywhere in either tree at a crossing is exactly that lean); Law 7 (dirt is loud at the gate, never silent); Law 4 (the rule 'nothing rides loose' becomes physics over the whole tree, not policy over a subtree). RULE 1: the change lives in build_inspector and reaches orient only through its declared interface.
how: (a) signature `working_tree_clean(row: dict, comp_dir: Path, *, repos: list[Path] | None = None) -> list[dict]`. (b) Default repos: walk up from comp_dir to the dir holding .git (as today); if none, return []. Then repos = [repo_root], plus repo_root.parent / 'CairnCommons' when that dir holds .git and is not repo_root. (c) rows = repo_truth(repos=repos)['measured']['repos'], imported from cairn.tools.orient.orient; a row with an error or no `dirty` key contributes nothing. dirty = {str(row repo path): row['dirty'] for rows with a non-empty dirty}. (d) If dirty is empty return []. Else return [_finding('working_tree_clean', row['component'], 'both trees are clean (no uncommitted changes in any repo)', expected=True, actual=False, dirty_count=<total paths>, dirty=dirty)]. Keep dirty_count (an existing tooth asserts it). (e) Update the docstring's provenance to cite this ticket. (f) In proofs/test_inspector.py, the existing working_tree_clean teeth pass repos=[wt_root] explicitly; add teeth 3a-3d after them with explicit repos=[A, B]; PROVES block entries keyed on c1cca2e3dc23, clauses 3a-3d. (g) Run only via bin/cairn test --netns cairn/machines/build_inspector/proofs/test_inspector.py.
falsifier: Done when cairn/machines/build_inspector/proofs/test_inspector.py is green under bin/cairn test --netns, with four new teeth red at HEAD d0317a77, each over two scratch git repos A (holding the component) and B, passed as repos=[A, B]: (3a) dirt in A outside the component's subtree gives exactly one working_tree_clean finding whose values name that path under A; (3b) dirt only in B gives one finding naming B's path; (3c) a modified intentions-congruency-lab/history.json in B gives one finding naming that path; (3d) both clean gives [], and a dirty file inside the component's subtree still gives one finding. Horizon: this voyage.
